result.reason: The grant appropriately covers affiliates and contractors and permits transfer in specified M&A transactions. However, it does not implement the required licence-duration and termination position: the licence is called irrevocable while remaining conditional on fee payment and termination under the existing Section, creating an internal conflict. It also fails to provide that paid-up licences are unconditionally perpetual and irrevocable or that subscription licences may be terminated only for uncured material breach. Applying irrevocability indiscriminately may also overreach for a subscription licence. Unrelated location and fee mechanics are otherwise preserved.
